xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: 09-09-2019 As per the MOU dated 13.08.2007 signed between claimants and respondent company for development of Plot No. 27 situated at Mahape, Navi Mumbai wherein in the year 2016 claimants raised the issue of non-performance of terms by the respondents and claimed interim compensation of Rs. 42 Lakhs wherein total claim mentioned under their statement of claims is Rs. 59 Crore, however, there is no justification/evidence or any documents in support of the said claim have been submitted by the claimants till date. Interim Application was decided in favour of company by Ld. Arbitrator and the interim claim of claimant was rejected. The CLaimant has filed Appeal before High Court, Bombay wherein the as per the High Court's directions STT Enterprise (i.e.e Third Party) have been made a party to the present appeal by the Original Claimant. STT ENterprise has already filed its reply and the Appeal is pending for hearing.
